question: Group all buildings at MIT into either owned or leased. For each group, state the ownership type, usage type, number of buildings, gross square footage, number of rooms, and the number of associated organizations. Display the ownership type only if it differs from the previous row. Include subtotals for each group and a grand total across all groups. The subtotal and grand total rows should not include ownership type and usage type. Footage should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    b.BUILDING_USE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS building_count,
    SUM(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA) AS gross_area,
    SUM(b.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS room_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING b
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT'
  GROUP BY b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, b.BUILDING_USE
  WITH ROLLUP
)

  CASE
    WHEN OWNERSHIP_TYPE IS NULL AND BUILDING_USE IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN BUILDING_USE IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN LAG(OWNERSHIP_TYPE) OVER (ORDER BY OWNERSHIP_TYPE, BUILDING_USE) = OWNERSHIP_TYPE THEN NULL
    ELSE OWNERSHIP_TYPE
  END AS ownership_type,
  CASE
    WHEN BUILDING_USE IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE BUILDING_USE
  END AS usage_type,
  building_count,
  FORMAT(ROUND(gross_area), 0) AS gross_square_footage,
  room_count,
  org_count
FROM base
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN OWNERSHIP_TYPE IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  CASE WHEN BUILDING_USE IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
  BUILDING_USE

         SUM(rooms) AS rooms,

  FROM base

),

  FROM base

MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC) SELECT s.academic_year, s.academic_year_desc, s.dept, s.units_range, s.units_variance, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.area_range, b.area_variance, b.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM SubjectUnitsStats AS s CROSS JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS b ORDER BY s.academic_year, s.dept, b.area_range DESC

WITH BuildingRoomArea AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING SUM(fr.AREA) > 1000), BuildingPeriods AS (SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, ic.total_room_area, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(bp.total_room_area) AS total_room_area, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM BuildingPeriods AS bp GROUP BY bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(bp.total_room_area) > 0), AcademicBuildingArea AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_assignable_area FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32') SELECT icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD, icte.running_assignable_area, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT bra.BUILDING_NAME, bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.total_room_area, aba.running_assignable_area, aba.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM BuildingRoomArea AS bra JOIN AcademicBuildingArea AS aba ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = aba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND bra.FISCAL_PERIOD = aba.FISCAL_PERIOD WHERE NOT bra.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL ORDER BY bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.BUILDING_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, fbh.CAMPUS_SECTOR, fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT'), access_level_variance AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY access_level_code_sort, campus_sector_sort) = ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE THEN NULL ELSE ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE END AS access_level_code, ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, campus_sector, num_of_rooms_variance, ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE AS join_access_level_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE END AS access_level_code_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE CAMPUS_SECTOR END AS campus_sector, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE CAMPUS_SECTOR END AS campus_sector_sort, ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, MAX(ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME) AS ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, CAMPUS_SECTOR WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY access_level_code_sort, campus_sector_sort), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fr.AREA FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '36'), floor_area_stats AS (SELECT f.FLOOR, i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(i.AREA) - MIN(i.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(i.AREA) AS area_variance, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE AS join_access_level_code FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS f ON i.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG GROUP BY f.FLOOR, i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) SELECT alv.access_level_code, alv.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, alv.campus_sector, alv.num_of_rooms_variance, fas.FLOOR, fas.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fas.area_range, fas.area_variance FROM access_level_variance AS alv JOIN floor_area_stats AS fas ON alv.join_access_level_code = fas.join_access_level_code ORDER BY alv.access_level_code, alv.campus_sector, fas.FLOOR

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_record_count, SUM(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS total_assignable_area FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS a JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE a.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND a.STATE = 'MA' AND b.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 1 AND NOT b.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> 32 GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.BUILDING_TYPE) SELECT ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area, AVG(h.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS avg_hist_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS h ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = h.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.BUILDING_TYPE, ic.hist_record_count, ic.total_assignable_area), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.area_range, inner_cte.area_variance, inner_cte.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.area_range DESC) SELECT s1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s1.BUILDING_NAME, s1.BUILDING_TYPE, s1.hist_record_count, s1.total_assignable_area, s1.avg_hist_num_of_rooms, s2.area_range, s2.area_variance, s2.area_stddev, s2.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS mit_assignable_area FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NAME = s2.BUILDING_NAME

WITH org_space_units AS (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(SPACE_UNIT) OVER (PARTITION BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS total_space_units, DLC_KEY FROM (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT t0.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')) AS inner_cte), org_hr_dept AS (SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.min_organization_number, f.DLC_KEY FROM (SELECT f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST') AND NOT f.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY f.ORGANIZATION, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS ic JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h2 ON ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS f ON ic.ORGANIZATION = f.ORGANIZATION WHERE h2.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area') SELECT osu.ORGANIZATION_NAME, osu.DESCRIPTION, osu.SPACE_UNIT, osu.total_space_units, ohd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ohd.organization_count, ohd.min_organization_number FROM org_space_units AS osu JOIN org_hr_dept AS ohd ON osu.DLC_KEY = ohd.DLC_KEY

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.COURSE_NUMBER FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE (lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE) = MASTER_SUBJECT_ID THEN NULL ELSE MASTER_SUBJECT_ID END AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, TIP_TERM_CODE, LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COURSE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME), rollup_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM rollup_cte ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT subq1.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, subq1.TIP_TERM_CODE, subq1.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.cip_code_variance FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON subq1.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER LEFT JOIN subq2 ON ssc.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subq1.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH math_units_stats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > (SELECT AVG(total_units) + STDDEV(total_units) FROM (SELECT SUM(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t)), math_subjects_faculty AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ed.FULL_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, AVG(ed.OFFICE_PHONE) OVER (PARTITION BY ed.LAST_NAME ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY` AS ed ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID LEFT JOIN `MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL` AS mld ON ed.MIT_ID = mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = 18 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mus.total_units, msf.SUBJECT_CODE, msf.SUBJECT_NUMBER, msf.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_FULL_NAME, msf.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER, msf.AVG_OFFICE_PHONE_WINDOW FROM math_units_stats AS mus JOIN math_subjects_faculty AS msf ON mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR = msf.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND mus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msf.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, msf.SUBJECT_CODE

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(fr.AREA) AS total_room_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC IN ('RESIDENT', 'LABS') AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY HAVING SUM(fr.AREA) > 1000), BuildingPeriods AS (SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, ic.total_room_area, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY), BuildingRoomArea AS (SELECT bp.BUILDING_NAME, bp.FISCAL_PERIOD, bp.total_room_area, bp.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM BuildingPeriods AS bp WHERE bp.total_room_area > 0), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_assignable_area FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32'), BuildingAssignableArea AS (SELECT icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, icte.BUILDING_NAME, icte.FISCAL_PERIOD, icte.running_assignable_area, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM inner_cte2 AS icte JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON icte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT bra.BUILDING_NAME, bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.total_room_area, baa.running_assignable_area, baa.EXT_GROSS_AREA FROM BuildingRoomArea AS bra JOIN BuildingAssignableArea AS baa ON bra.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = baa.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND bra.FISCAL_PERIOD = baa.FISCAL_PERIOD ORDER BY bra.FISCAL_PERIOD, bra.BUILDING_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'), cte_subject_units AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) -          SUM(buildings) AS buildings,
         SUM(gross) AS gross,
         SUM(rooms) AS rooms,
         SUM(orgs) AS orgs
  FROM base
  GROUP BY OWNERSHIP_TYPE
),
grand AS (
  SELECT SUM(buildings) AS buildings,
         SUM(gross) AS gross,
         SUM(rooms) AS rooms,
         SUM(orgs) AS orgs
  FROM base
),
detail AS (
  SELECT OWNERSHIP_TYPE, BUILDING_USE, buildings, gross, rooms, orgs,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY OWNERSHIP_TYPE, BUILDING_USE) AS rn
  FROM base
),
sub_rows AS (
  SELECT s.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
         MAX(d.rn) + 1 AS rn,
         NULL AS BUILDING_USE,
         s.buildings, s.gross, s.rooms, s.orgs
  FROM sub s
  JOIN detail d ON d.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = s.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
  GROUP BY s.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, s.buildings, s.gross, s.rooms, s.orgs
),
grand_rows AS (
